SELECT p."PurchaseId", p."CreatedAt", p."CreatedBy", p."GuestEmail", p."GuestName", p."ModifiedAt", p."ModifiedBy", p."PurchaseDate", p."TotalCost", p."UpdatedAt", p."UserId", s."EventId", s."PurchaseId", s."CreatedAt", s."CreatedBy", s."ModifiedAt", s."ModifiedBy", s."PurchaseDate", s."Rating", s."TicketQuantity", s."UpdatedAt", s."Id", s."AvailableTickets", s."CategoryId", s."CreatedAt0", s."CreatedByUserId", s."Description", s."EndDate", s."EventStatus", s."StartDate", s."TicketPrice", s."Title", s."UpdatedAt0"
FROM "Purchases" AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT e."EventId", e."PurchaseId", e."CreatedAt", e."CreatedBy", e."ModifiedAt", e."ModifiedBy", e."PurchaseDate", e."Rating", e."TicketQuantity", e."UpdatedAt", e0."Id", e0."AvailableTickets", e0."CategoryId", e0."CreatedAt" AS "CreatedAt0", e0."CreatedByUserId", e0."Description", e0."EndDate", e0."EventStatus", e0."StartDate", e0."TicketPrice", e0."Title", e0."UpdatedAt" AS "UpdatedAt0"
    FROM "EventPurchases" AS e
    INNER JOIN "Events" AS e0 ON e."EventId" = e0."Id"

SELECT p."PurchaseId", p."CreatedAt", p."CreatedBy", p."GuestEmail", p."GuestName", p."ModifiedAt", p."ModifiedBy", p."PurchaseDate", p."TotalCost", p."UpdatedAt", p."UserId", s."EventId", s."PurchaseId", s."CreatedAt", s."CreatedBy", s."ModifiedAt", s."ModifiedBy", s."PurchaseDate", s."Rating", s."TicketQuantity", s."UpdatedAt", s."Id", s."AvailableTickets", s."CategoryId", s."CreatedAt0", s."CreatedByUserId", s."Description", s."EndDate", s."EventStatus", s."StartDate", s."TicketPrice", s."Title", s."UpdatedAt0"
FROM "Purchases" AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT e."EventId", e."PurchaseId", e."CreatedAt", e."CreatedBy", e."ModifiedAt", e."ModifiedBy", e."PurchaseDate", e."Rating", e."TicketQuantity", e."UpdatedAt", e0."Id", e0."AvailableTickets", e0."CategoryId", e0."CreatedAt" AS "CreatedAt0", e0."CreatedByUserId", e0."Description", e0."EndDate", e0."EventStatus", e0."StartDate", e0."TicketPrice", e0."Title", e0."UpdatedAt" AS "UpdatedAt0"
    FROM "EventPurchases" AS e
    INNER JOIN "Events" AS e0 ON e."EventId" = e0."Id"

    SELECT e."EventId", e."PurchaseId", e."CreatedAt", e."CreatedBy", e."ModifiedAt", e."ModifiedBy", e."PurchaseDate", e."Rating", e."TicketQuantity", e."UpdatedAt", e0."Id", e0."AvailableTickets", e0."CategoryId", e0."CreatedAt" AS "CreatedAt0", e0."CreatedByUserId", e0."Description", e0."EndDate", e0."EventStatus", e0."StartDate", e0."TicketPrice", e0."Title", e0."UpdatedAt" AS "UpdatedAt0"
    FROM "EventPurchases" AS e
    INNER JOIN "Events" AS e0 ON e."EventId" = e0."Id"
) AS s ON p."PurchaseId" = s."PurchaseId"
ORDER BY p."PurchaseId", s."EventId", s."PurchaseId"

SELECT p."PurchaseId", p."CreatedAt", p."CreatedBy", p."GuestEmail", p."GuestName", p."ModifiedAt", p."ModifiedBy", p."PurchaseDate", p."TotalCost", p."UpdatedAt", p."UserId", s."EventId", s."PurchaseId", s."CreatedAt", s."CreatedBy", s."ModifiedAt", s."ModifiedBy", s."PurchaseDate", s."Rating", s."TicketQuantity", s."UpdatedAt", s."Id", s."AvailableTickets", s."CategoryId", s."CreatedAt0", s."CreatedByUserId", s."Description", s."EndDate", s."EventStatus", s."StartDate", s."TicketPrice", s."Title", s."UpdatedAt0"
FROM "Purchases" AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT e."EventId", e."PurchaseId", e."CreatedAt", e."CreatedBy", e."ModifiedAt", e."ModifiedBy", e."PurchaseDate", e."Rating", e."TicketQuantity", e."UpdatedAt", e0."Id", e0."AvailableTickets", e0."CategoryId", e0."CreatedAt" AS "CreatedAt0", e0."CreatedByUserId", e0."Description", e0."EndDate", e0."EventStatus", e0."StartDate", e0."TicketPrice", e0."Title", e0."UpdatedAt" AS "UpdatedAt0"
    FROM "EventPurchases" AS e
    INNER JOIN "Events" AS e0 ON e."EventId" = e0."Id"
